about: Cases for the display grid. Each case holds a real stamp cut from a frame of SPHEREx (key, the turn of north on the detector) and what to_display_grid must give for it; null stands for NaN. size is the side of the display grid; its target pixel is (size // 2, size // 2), 0-based, first row at the lowest y; east is to the left and north is up, PIXEL_ARCSEC (6.15) arcsec per pixel. For the output pixel (i, j): east = (c - i) * pixelDeg, north = (j - c) * pixelDeg, c = size // 2; with [a, b, c2, d] = sky.cd and det = a*d - b*c2: dx = (d*east - b*north) / det, dy = (a*north - c2*east) / det; the source pixel is (floor(tx + dx + 0.5), floor(ty + dy + 0.5)), and it is -1, -1 (data NaN, flags 0) when outside the stamp. data, flags, sx, sy are row by row, first row at the lowest y. gridSky is the sky of the display grid. localSky holds, for pixels of recorded frames (the folders of tests/fixtures/frames), what local_sky must give: x and y are full-frame pixels, 0-based.
